bibl.title: The Bawit monastery of Apa Apollo in the Hermopolite nome and its relations with the 'world outside'.
bibl.seg: Joanna Wegner, The Bawit monastery of Apa Apollo in the Hermopolite nome and its relations with the 'world outside'.
bibl.note: Gathers papyrological testimonies of contacts of the monastic community at Bawit and its members with 'the world outside': officials, tenants, and various partners in economic activities. Investigates the role played by these external connections in the life of the monastery in the sixth-eighth centuries and the extent to which economic and fiscal circumstances could influence the administration of the community.
